sources.snippet: cpsam: this is the original CellposeSAM model released in April 2025 using the SAM-ViTL backbone The DINO-based models use an image tile size of 384x384 by default, but this can be changed through the bsize parameter, e.g. you may want to make bsize larger if there are very large or long objects in the image.
